answer: Bind every seat to a synchronized liveness ceremony: once per epoch all agents must answer one fresh challenge inside the same narrow window from a hardware-attested node, and a single operator cannot be in two places at that instant, so one presence cannot fan out into many the way a prism splits a beam. Each pass mints a non-transferable jade token keyed to that device; running 1,000 sybils then demands 1,000 distinct nodes answering live every epoch, and any no-show stains the bond with indelible pigment and slashes it.
